''See also: [[Endless Sword Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Endless Sword is a specialized combat [[Path]] and its associated [[Ruler technique]]. Centered on the concept of [[vital aura]], the [[Path]] is designed exclusively for offensive purposes; it lacks defensive capabilities, as its [[sword aura]] is used solely for cutting rather than shielding. Practitioners can utilize [[madra]] to reinforce weapons, making them stronger as they move through the air, or even forge temporary tools and blades from their own power. The Endless Sword technique manifests as a storm of invisible, slashing blades that can be controlled with varying degrees of precision. Mastery of the [[Path]] is categorized into stages, such as "storm," where aura explodes in an uncontrolled manner, and the more refined "sword like the wind" stage. At its most advanced levels, the technique can achieve [[aura resonance]], a phenomenon where striking one source of [[sword aura]] causes a cascading reaction capable of massive destruction. A highly potent variation known as the [[Final Sword]] allows a practitioner to forge a massive, translucent replica of their weapon out of [[madra]]. While highly effective at shredding targets and suppressing enemies, the [[Path]] is physically demanding and requires significant [[madra]] to execute effectively.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Endless Sword is a weapon characterized by distinct levels of mastery. [[Yerin]] has progressed to the storm stage of her control over the blade, allowing her to successfully activate it. The sword is capable of producing pulses of [[sword aura|sword-aura]] that can be utilized to deflect incoming attacks. Furthermore, the weapon is highly efficient, requiring very little [[madra]] to operate.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Endless Sword technique allows [[Yerin]] to suppress an entire room with its power. When activated, the technique energizes the aura surrounding both the user and their [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]]. This ability manifests through invisible claws or a blade that can strike targets, even possessing enough force to cause trees to explode. Ultimately, the technique gathers around [[Yerin]]'s six [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] as well as the sword left by the [[Sword Sage]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Endless Sword is a specialized technique and lineage of which [[Yerin]] serves as the sole heir. This martial art can be activated by a [[Sword Sage]], and its power is capable of causing deep cuts to both skin and clothing. The technique features a specific stage known as sword like the wind, and its application can ripple through dense [[sword aura]]. Throughout various encounters, the style has been utilized by others, including Ruby and the [[Blood Shadow]], though [[Yerin]] maintains the ambition to become the next [[Sage of the Endless Sword]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Sword Sage]] can activate the [[Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Endless Sword]] technique has a stage called 'sword like the wind'.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Yerin]] aims to be the next [[Sage of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Endless Sword]] is a lineage or group of which [[Yerin]] is the sole heir.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" />}}</li>
